tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nai gus brgyud 'debs a yig chos 'byung ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/

a yig chos kyi 'byung gnas pho brang du/ /a dkar zag med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /a bhi ṣ-iñtsas sems kyi dri ma 'khrud/ /a haṃ mi phyed bde stong rdo rje 'chang*/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /dag byed stong ra'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /'gal rkyen nad gdon sdig sgrub sbyangs pa dang*/ /mthun rkyen rtags gsum ci rigs shar nas kyang*/ /ting 'dzin myur du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mi rtog gtum mos rnam rtog bud shing bsregs/ / bde chen gtum mos sdug bsngal tshang tshing 'jom/ /zung 'jug gtum mos ye shes me lce 'bar/ /gtum mo mthar byin mkha' 'gro nai gu ma/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /zas dang gos dang stan gyi rnal 'byor gyi/ /spyod lam kun tu gtum mo 'bral med cing*/ /srid pa'i dbang thob gegs kun rang sar grol/ /rlung 'byong bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /snang ba sgyu mar rtogs pa'i chags sdang grol/ /rang sems sgyu mar shar ba'i 'khrul pa dag /gnyis 'dzin sgyu ma shar pa'i 'od gsal shar/ /sgyu ma'i don rtogs khyung po rnal 'byor la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /yang rab bla ma'i mos gus 'bral med cing*/ /'bring gis brjod bral bar ma chad du sgoms/ /tha ma'i kun kyang sgyu mar sbyangs nas ni/ /zhen med rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rmi lam lta bur chos rnams thugs su chud/ /smi lam nyid kyang bden med sgyu mar gzigs/ /rmi lam sgyu ma'ang 'od gsal gnas gyur te/ /rmi lam mthar phyin mnyam med rmog cog pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'dun pa'i gnad kyis rmi lam bzung nas ni/ /sbyang dang spel dang sprul sgyur sna tshogs kyis/ /yul snang rnam bzhi gtan la phab nas kyang*/ /gsal stong 'dzin med 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/

/gsal stong zhen med 'od gsal rang gsal gyis/ /zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal mthar sbyang nas/ /bde chen mthar thug 'od gsal mngon gyur te/ /'od gsal dag pa gnyis ldan skyer sgang ba/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ / 'od gsal zung bzhi lam du khyer ba dang*/ /bsre 'pho'i gnad dang gegs sel bogs 'don gyis/ /dam tshig ma nyams 'char sgo ngo zin nas/ /'od gsal nyams myong 'byong par byin gyis rlobs/ /chos sku 'pho ba'i sgyu ma lam du khyer/ / zung 'jug 'pho ba'i yi dam lam du khyer/ /byin rlabs 'pho ba'i bla ma lam du khyer/ /'pho ba'i lam la mnga' brnyes gnyan ston pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /lam khyer gsum gyis 'pho ba mthar phyin nas/ / 'chug med mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid pa dang*/ /mthar thug rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /'bad med lhun gyi 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rmi lam bar dor sprul bsgyur mthar phyin nas/ /skye shi bar dor 'od gsal rgyun chad med/ /srid pa bar do'i rang zhal lhun gyis grub/ /bar dor rang dag sangs rgyas ston pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi ya nga'i g.yang sa sogs/ /bar do'i 'phrang du mchug med thabs kyi gnad/ /lam khyer gsum gyis 'jigs pa rang sar dag /sku gsum mngon du gyur par byin gyis rlobs/ /phyi rol yul rnams snang stong rgyas btab cing*/ / nang gi sems nyid gsal stong rgya yis btab/ /rang lus lha sku bde stong rgyas btab nas/ /phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs shangs ston pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon 'gro rang babs rnam gsum gnad la dbab/ /dngos gzhi skyon bzhi las grol nyams len gyis/ /mthar thug sku bzhi rang shar lhun gyis grub/ /phyag chen gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/

/snang ba'i rol pa bla ma yin dam lha/ /grag stong brjod bral yan lag drug cu'i gsungs/ /gsal la 'dzin med bde gsal mi rtog thugs/ /lam khyer mthar phyin khyung po tshul khrims mgon /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /spyod lam kun tu snang ba sna tshogs kun/ /bla ma yi dam sgyu mar lam khyer nas/ /sems nyid 'od gsal 'dzin med gnad kyi ni/ /mtshan rtogs rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo bye ba'i zhal gyi gsung*/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug mched las legs brgyud nas/ / mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig nai gu su kha'i chos/ /mkha' 'gros rjes bzung tshad ldan ri khrod pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' spyod dkar dmar bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ma/ /mkha' spyod ril bu'i sgrub pa mthar phyin nas/ /mkha' spyod 'pho ba'i rig 'dzin nye lam gyis/ /mkha' sbyod zhing du bsgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang lus lha sku snang stong mtha' dang bral/ /sems nyid 'dzin med 'od gsal lhun gyis grub/ /'ching bar byed pa rang sang dag pa ste/ /'chi med don rtogs mkhyen ldan shangs dkar ba/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /blos byas rtsol ba'i dri ma kun spangs shing*/ /tha mal zhen pa'i 'dzin pa rang dag nas/ /snang la rang bzhin med par lha yi sku/ /rang sems 'chi med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ / bar do'i srid pa lag mthil spu ji bzhin/ /ma 'dres ye shes spyan gyis legs gzigs nas/ /snying rjes 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyang*/ /thar pa'i lam du 'khrid mdzad sangs rgyas dpal/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam mang 'gro ba'i skye sgo mtha' yas pa/ /rnam dag ye shes 'khor lo'i legs sbyangs nas/ /rnam par myong ba'i lam sgrib kun bsal te/ /'chug med longs sku thob par byin gyis rlobs/

/ro rkyang nyi zla'i bsgrod pa dhu ti ru/ / yongs su 'jug pa'i btsan thabs sbyaur ba yis/ /las rlung rgyu ba'i grong khyer kun bcom nas/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /phyag rgya bcing grol bum pa shing rta can/ /lus sems 'chi med grub pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /chags can rnal 'byor pho nya'i myur lam las/ /'ja' lus dngos su 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhi ba'i dbyings las thugs rje'i khros pa'i gar/ /myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i skur bzhengs nas/ /bar chad bdud dpung g.yul las legs rgyal ba'i/ /rgya sgom bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /las bzhi'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i srung ma'i tshogs/ / dus las mi 'da' bran du 'khol nus shing*/ /srid zhi'i phan bde'i dpal gyi skal bzang rnams/ /re ba ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed rmad byung dang*/ /rgyal sras sems dpa'i rlabs chen mdzad pa dang*/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu kun gyi lta spyod la/ /rjes su yi rang mthar phyin grol mchog la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /thar pa'i lam ston dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ /thar pa'i lam mchog yang dag dam pa'i chos/ /thar pa'i lam du ches pa'i mched grogs la/ /dag snang phyogs med 'byung par byin gyis rlobs/ /thabs lam gtum mo las rgya zung 'brel zhing*/ /grol lam gtum mo sgyu lus zung 'jug gi /'phrin las don gnyis phun tshogs lha dbang grags/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /dgyes mdzad gtum mo bde mchog gzhan lus dang*/ / gsang 'dus sgyu lus mā ya 'od gsal sogs/ /'jigs mdzad 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i don 'grub par/ /rnam lnga'i brgyud don rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/

/dri mdzad gzhan don bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs shing*/ /smon lam dbang gis sngags lam bkra shis chos/ /bka' rgya grol bar ston mdzad sgrol ba'i mgon/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rin chen sgrom bu lta bur dmigs pa'i gnad/ /zab don 'phrul gyis gnad don kun shes sheng*/ /rig sngags 'khros pa'i dbang mo dpag yas kyi/ khams gyi dbang bsgyur stsol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhi'i gnas lugs sku gsum rang shar gyis/ /lam gyi 'khrul pa glo bur sgrib sbyangs nas/ /'bras bu dag pa gnyis ldan kun dga'i mtshan/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /thabs mkhas gzhan gyi don la ma rmongs zhing*/ /gang du sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed nus pa'i/ /bsam pa'i don rnams yid bzhin kun 'grub pa/ / smon lam yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khrul med lam gyi yon tan kun rdzogs shing*/ /'khrul pa'i snang brnyan dge legs dpal gyur pa'i/ /dge legs kun 'byung rnal 'byor byams pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor 'das kun gyi bkra shis dge legs rnams/ /bkra shis dpal yon bzang po'i phun tshogs kyis/ /dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud phyogs kun tu/ /dar zhing rgyas la yun gnas byin gyi rlobs/ /mdo sngags rgyud sde kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /ma lus thugs su chud cing dpal shangs pa'i/ /bstan pa'i srog shing byams pa yon tan mgon/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrod pa'i thegs pa'i mchog /lam du sgoms pas bar chad kun zhi zhing*/ /mthar thug sku bzhi'i ye shes mngon du gyur/ /'bad med myur du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyes kun smon lam bzang po'i rgyud sde'i bcud/ /nges gsang mkha' 'gro'i bka' babs man ngag la/ /blo gros yangs pa kun dga' lhun grub

la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya nyams med chos/ /byin rlabs chu bo'i bka' rgyun mi nyams shing*/ /grub thob brgyud pa'i zam pa ma chad par/ /nyams dang rtogs pa 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// // zhes pa 'di ni tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / ༈ 'di'i kha skong rje tshul khrims kyis mdzad pa ni/ sngon gom smon lam bzang po'i legs byas kyis/ /nyer grangs mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud bdud rtsi'i bcud/ khyod thugs rin chen bum bzang chud sor ldems/ /chos drug mthar phyin ngag dbang blo gros la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs /sgrib gnyis bag chags 'thug po'i non pa'i dri/ /chos drug chab kyis lhag med 'khrud pa dang*/ /'gro ba'i nad gso sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rang gzhan smin zhing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ khyod gsung thugs kyi nying khu 'dzin pa la/ /mkhyen rab thugs rjes nam yang mi dor zhing*/ /sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i brtse ba can/ /rdo rje 'chang chen ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs la/ /gsolab 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam kun rtsa rgyud bla ma'i rnam thar la/ /mi phyed dad pa'i rjes 'jug snying khong nas/ /rtse gcig gus pa'i gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /zab lam mthar phyin mkha' spyod bsgrod par shog /bka' drin 'khor med rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ /bcu gsum snying po'i don rtsol sgrol ba'i mgon/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'dren mchog chos kyi rje/ /kirti dharma warti'i mtshan can la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ khyed kyi zab gsung chos drug bdud rtsi'i ro/ /bdag blo ma dag 'dzin rtog kun bkrus te/ /'khor ba gnas 'gyur ye shes mngon mthong ba'i/ /he ru ka nyid thob par byin gyis rlobs// // zhes so/ /bkra shis/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/
